H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H389: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H1747: stillness; adverbially, silently; abstractly quiet, trust
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H3444: something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H6697: properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous)
H4869: defence, high fort (tower), refuge, Misgab, a place in Moab
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H4131: to waver; by implication, to slip, shake, fall
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H575: where?; hence, whither?, when?; also hither and thither
H2050: properly, to break in upon, i.e. to assail
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H7523: properly, to dash in pieces, i.e. kill (a human being), especially to murder
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H7023: a wall (as built in a trench)
H5186: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
H1447: a circumvallation; by implication, an inclosure
H7613: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively, elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character
H3289: to advise; reflexively, to deliberate or resolve
H5080: to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.)
H7521: to be pleased with; specifically, to satisfy adebt
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H7130: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
H7043: to be (causatively, make) light, literally (swift, small, sharp, etc.) or figuratively (easy, trifling, vile, etc.)
H1826: to be dumb; by implication, to be astonished, to stop; also to perish
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H8615: literally a cord (as an attachment); figuratively, expectancy
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H6256: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H8210: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H3824: the heart (as the most interior organ);
H1892: emptiness or vanity; figuratively, something transitory and unsatisfactory; often used as an adverb
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H3976: (only in the dual) a pair of scales
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H1891: to be vain in act, word, or expectation; specifically to lead astray
H2428: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
H5107: to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter
H7896: to place (in a very wide application)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H7999: to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively, to be (causatively, make) completed; by implication, to be friendly; by extension, to reciprocate (in various applications)
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
